learning_outcomes.text: Name the energetic properties of pure substances and pure substance mixtures.
Derive calculation equations for the idealized model bodies 'perfect gas' and 'incompressible body' and state their range of validity.
Graphically represent and calculate state changes of model bodies depending on process control.
Balance the process variables heat and work with the associated change in energy forms of closed and open systems (1st and 2nd law of thermodynamics).
Determine graphically and analytically the feasibility and efficiency of an energy conversion using the state variable entropy and evaluate measures for increasing efficiency.

Graphically and analytically represent clockwise cyclic processes (heat engines) with perfect gas as a model fluid for comparison and real processes, and calculate thermodynamic characteristic values.
Name different states of aggregation and calculate the phase change liquid-gas depending on pressure and temperature.

syllabus_topics: Cyclic processes of a perfect gas
